questions.question: DEC-037 calls option 0 illegal for the pointer crossings and says a value above 4 gives the 4-FF cell. DEC-002 says there is no elaboration check and illegal values are undefined. Is a value above 4 defined or undefined? Is option 0 on a pointer crossing legal and tested?

The default is 2 synchronizer stages (DEC-004), and the cell type also defaults to 2. How do the synchronizer-stage parameter and PARA_AFIFO_CELL_TYPE relate? Does the metastability latency S-1..S+1 depend on S or on the cell type?
Can occupancy for o_full_thr and o_empty_thr be checked exactly, given that each flag uses a synchronized, delayed pointer from the other domain? What tolerance applies?
ASM-003 says read data stays stable under the pointer protocol, while DEC-012 randomizes the synchronizer latency per bit. Is any assertion on read-data stability expected?
